'''2024 Online Retro Event for Charity''' was the Players Committee Classic No-V (Premiere to Death Star II) charity event on GEMP, 11 May – 6 July 2024. [[Patrick Lima]] finished 1st among the published lists.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-07-online-retro-event-for-charity-classic-no-v/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' 11 May – 6 July 2024
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1426779#p1426779 forum]
